recent.text: P.J. Washington was downgraded to doubtful with an illness for tonight's Mavericks-Clippers game. Dusty May praised his defense after Wednesday's win. “I thought he was able to guard smaller guys,” May said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/ecDf9pUWmU

recent.text: Cooper Flagg scored 33 points on 11-of-15 shooting against Golden State. His nine assists produced another 21 points. “He was all over the place tonight,” Dusty May said after the win. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/tjVIRrfyn2

recent.text: Tarik Biberović and Sergio De Larrea have done most of their rehab work in small groups around Mavericks practice. “The report this morning was that they’re both making progress,” Dusty May said Friday. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/sFOqxVx1Tu

recent.text: P.J. Washington hit five 3s and blocked three shots in the Mavericks’ win over Golden State. Dusty May singled out his defense against smaller guards. “The shot just fell for me,” Washington said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/L11gi7S5Dm
